D: Batman takes on the Penguin and Catwoman at Christmas time.
P: Serve the snacks when the Gotham Christmas tree lights up.
S: the Penguin eats his fish raw, we'll smoke ours
Dark rye buttered, topped with smoked salmon, crème fraîche, capers and dill, cut into fingers.
Selina's saucer of milk, grown up
Small glasses of cream liqueur shaken with cold milk and a pinch of nutmeg, or vanilla milk for anyone avoiding the liqueur.
Score chestnuts with a cross, soak 20 minutes, roast at 220C for 20 minutes until the shells curl, wrap in a towel 5 minutes, peel warm.
M: Pork loin with crackling: score and dry the skin overnight, salt, roast at 240C for 30 minutes then 180C to 63C inside. Apple and sage sauce, roast potatoes.
Flathead in a beer batter at 180C, double-fried chips, mushy peas and tartare, served in newspaper.
W: Vanilla cupcakes with white buttercream, a tiny sugar Christmas tree on top and shredded coconut snow.

Brandy, milk, sugar syrup and vanilla shaken with ice, strained into a coupe, grated nutmeg on top.

s.note: the Penguin eats his fish raw, we'll smoke ours
s.how: Butter 6 slices dark rye bread. Top with 200g smoked salmon, a spoon of crème fraîche, a few capers and dill sprigs. Cut into fingers with a sharp knife and serve cold on a dark plate.

Cut a cross into 500g chestnuts and soak in water for 20 minutes. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes until the shells curl back. Wrap in a tea towel for 5 minutes, then peel warm and sprinkle with flaky salt.

m.how: Score a 1.5kg pork loin and dry uncovered overnight. Salt well and roast at 240C for 30 minutes, then 180C until 63C inside. Roast 1kg potatoes alongside. Cook 3 apples with sage and a little sugar to a chunky sauce.

w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, add 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake 12 cupcakes at 180C for 18 minutes. Ice with 150g butter beaten with 300g icing sugar, then add a sugar tree and shredded coconut snow.

d.note: Selina's saucer of milk, grown up
d.how: For each drink, shake 45ml brandy, 90ml cold milk, 15ml sugar syrup and a drop of vanilla hard with ice. Strain into a chilled coupe and grate nutmeg over the top. Makes four.
